toegepas.voor: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie, en net hitte beweeg.
toegepas.na: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie. Net hitte beweeg.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second clause contrasts with the first, so 'en' joins them weakly; two short sentences state the contrast more clearly.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins a contrast weakly, so 'net hitte beweeg' trails as an afterthought
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two short sentences state the cold-does-not-enter / only-heat-moves contrast more crisply for Grade 5, with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: die magneet trek die spyker aan en die draad glad nie
toegepas.na: die magneet trek die spyker aan, maar glad nie die draad nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The elliptical 'en die draad glad nie' is incomplete; a contrast with 'maar' and the full negative frame reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: the clipped ellipsis 'en die draad glad nie' reads incomplete
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'maar glad nie die draad nie' is the natural Afrikaans contrast with the full negative frame, and the same things are attracted and not attracted.

toegepas.voor: Om metaal te wees beteken dus nie om magneties te wees nie
toegepas.na: Nie alle metale is dus magneties nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The infinitive construction is wooden for Grade 5; the plain sentence says the same thing.
toegepas.fout: 'Om metaal te wees beteken nie om magneties te wees nie' copies the English 'being X does not mean being Y'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nie alle metale is dus magneties nie' says the same thing in plain Afrikaans and follows directly from the list of unattracted metals before it.

laat_vaar.na: en 'n krap in die verf laat die staal
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Says where the scratch is, so the learner links it to the paint in the previous clause; nothing new is added.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Verf lê bo-op' and 'daaronder' already place the scratch in the paint; the addition lengthens the sentence and repeats 'verf'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Verslyt' is the usual standard form for wearing away; 'slyt' reads dated.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'slyt' is current standard Afrikaans alongside 'verslyt', so this is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: wanneer lug en water daarby uitkom
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Bykom' alone is vague; 'daarby uitkom' matches the study text's 'by die yster uitkom' and is clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition, and 'wanneer lug en water bykom' is already idiomatic Afrikaans for air and water reaching the iron.
